propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke review_plan after the EDIT event commits and map the verdict to exit codes 0/1/2/11 per ADR 0040

claim --review must sense gate applicability via _plan_review_gate_applies and claim_gate_check, proceed to claim only on PASS verdict, and exit 1/2/11 on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable without invoking claim core
both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import and release the store flock before invoking review_plan, which holds the lock only for its own brief signing re-check
a raising review_plan must propagate through the standard CLI error handler, leaving the edit committed and never attempting the claim
claim --review must print a skip notice and proceed normally when the plan-review gate does not apply, and the flag must not propagate through parent-first cascade
